nodes.name: Python Programming Fundamentals
nodes.description: Variables, loops, functions, object-oriented programming (OOP), and error handling in Python.

nodes.name: Linear Algebra & Vector Calculus
nodes.description: Vectors, matrices, matrix multiplication, eigenvalues, eigenvectors, gradients, and partial derivatives.

nodes.name: Data Manipulation with NumPy & Pandas
nodes.description: Multidimensional arrays, dataframes, indexing, grouping, merging, and cleaning dirty datasets.

nodes.name: Probability & Applied Statistics
nodes.description: Random variables, distributions, Bayes theorem, hypothesis testing, p-values, and confidence intervals.

nodes.name: Supervised & Unsupervised Machine Learning
nodes.description: Linear regression, decision trees, random forests, SVMs, k-means clustering, and cross-validation.

nodes.name: Feature Engineering & Model Evaluation
nodes.description: Feature scaling, one-hot encoding, PCA, ROC-AUC, precision-recall, and bias-variance tradeoff.

nodes.name: Deep Learning & Neural Networks
nodes.description: Perceptrons, backpropagation, activation functions, optimizers (Adam, SGD), PyTorch/TensorFlow.

nodes.name: NLP & Generative AI / Transformers
nodes.description: Tokenization, embeddings, self-attention, BERT, GPT, and fine-tuning Large Language Models.

nodes.name: Computer Vision & CNNs
nodes.description: Convolutional layers, pooling, object detection (YOLO), segmentation, and OpenCV techniques.

nodes.name: MLOps & Model Deployment
nodes.description: FastAPI model serving, Docker containerization, model registries, and drift monitoring.

nodes.name: Modern HTML5 & Responsive CSS3
nodes.description: Semantic HTML, Flexbox, Grid, media queries, and responsive design systems.

nodes.name: JavaScript ES6+ & DOM Manipulation
nodes.description: Arrow functions, promises, async/await, closures, fetch API, and browser events.

nodes.name: React.js & State Management
nodes.description: Components, JSX, useState, useEffect, custom hooks, and context API.

nodes.name: Node.js & Express RESTful APIs
nodes.description: Server architecture, middleware, routing, JWT authentication, and error handling.

nodes.name: Databases (PostgreSQL & MongoDB)
nodes.description: Relational schemas, SQL queries, indexing, ORMs (Prisma), NoSQL document storage, and transactions.

nodes.name: Full-Stack Architecture & Auth
nodes.description: Client-server communication, OAuth, cookies/sessions, CORS, role-based access control, and state sync.

nodes.name: CI/CD & Cloud Deployment for Web
nodes.description: GitHub Actions, Docker containers, deployment on Render/Vercel/AWS, and SSL configuration.

nodes.name: SQL for Data Analysis & Reporting
nodes.description: Aggregations, Window functions, JOINs, CTEs, and cohort analysis using relational queries.

nodes.name: Python for Data Science
nodes.description: Jupyter notebooks, Pandas dataframes, data munging, date/time manipulation, and regex.

nodes.name: Exploratory Data Analysis & Tableau/Seaborn
nodes.description: Storytelling with data, correlation matrices, distribution plots, Seaborn, Matplotlib, and dashboard design.

nodes.name: Statistical Modeling & A/B Testing
nodes.description: Sample size calculation, p-values, ANOVA, regression diagnostics, and A/B test experiment design.

nodes.name: Predictive Analytics & Forecasting
nodes.description: Time series analysis (ARIMA, Prophet), customer churn prediction, and business metric optimization.

nodes.name: Computer Networks & Protocols
nodes.description: OSI model, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, subnetting, packet inspection with Wireshark.

nodes.name: Linux Command Line & System Security
nodes.description: Bash scripting, file permissions, users/groups, SSH keys, cron jobs, and firewall setup.

nodes.name: Network Security & Cryptography
nodes.description: Symmetric/asymmetric encryption, hashing, TLS/SSL, IDS/IPS, and VPN configurations.

nodes.name: Ethical Hacking & Web Vulnerabilities
nodes.description: OWASP Top 10, SQL Injection, XSS, CSRF, Burp Suite, and ethical vulnerability disclosure.

nodes.name: SOC Analysis & Incident Response
nodes.description: SIEM tools (Splunk, Elastic), log analysis, threat hunting, digital forensics, and incident remediation.

nodes.name: Cloud Computing Fundamentals (AWS/Azure)
nodes.description: Cloud concepts (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS), regions, IAM security, compute instances (EC2), and S3 storage.

nodes.name: Docker & Containerization
nodes.description: Dockerfiles, images, containers, multi-stage builds, Docker Compose, and networking.

nodes.name: Kubernetes & Cluster Orchestration
nodes.description: Pods, Deployments, Services, ConfigMaps, Ingress controllers, and Helm charts.

nodes.name: Infrastructure as Code with Terraform
nodes.description: Terraform providers, resource state management, variables, modules, and automated cloud provisioning.

nodes.name: CI/CD Automation (GitHub Actions & GitLab)
nodes.description: Automated testing, build artifacts, linting workflows, secrets management, and automated release deployment.
